title: Williams-Brice Stadium
scope: Williams–Brice Stadium as depicted in the October 2006 game-day photographs, including the field, concrete bowl, opposing upper decks, north scoreboard and south end-zone expansion.
limitations: The depiction is dated October 2006. Later renovations, including the 2012 north video board and subsequent concourse upgrades, are outside this configuration.
Mapped plan controls fix the field, main deck spans and site orientation. Deck sectional heights, individual benches, signwork, services and small fixture details use bounded estimates.
